incidents.name: SellToken router getAmountOut used as price
incidents.notes: The SellToken router takes PancakeSwap's getAmountOut() as the SELLC price, so a flash loan moved the pair and let the attacker sell SELLC to the router far above its real value.

sources.ref: onchain review: SellToken router 0x57Db19127617B77c8abd9420b5a35502b59870D6 created 2023-03-30T11:08:46Z by 0x20d815e42ecdeff5cc14b142df817825b15b88dd, unrelated to attack sender 0x1581262fd72776ba5da2337c4c4e1b92c6e36ae6; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the attack contract 0x19ed7cd5f1d2bd02713131344d6890454d7c599f netted 8.5643 WBNB; 8.5643 WBNB x $309.78 at incidentTimestamp 1683961936 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,653. Boundary row: the router behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.

incidents.name: SellToken router unchecked user-supplied settlement input
incidents.notes: The SellToken03 contract trusts a caller-supplied token/amount pair when settling a sale and never validates it against what was actually received, so the attacker had it pay out against a worthless input.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x84Be9475051a08ee5364fBA44De7FE83a5eCC4f1 created 2023-03-23T12:46:48Z by 0x20d815e42ecdeff5cc14b142df817825b15b88dd, unrelated to attack sender 0x0060129430df7ea188be3d8818404a2d40896089; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The exploit transaction is funded by a 446.64 WBNB DODO flash loan that is repaid in full, so the profit is not visible as a net WBNB flow; lossUsd uses the ~$109k reported by DeFiHackLabs and Eocene.
